caveats: Classifier numbers use onnxruntime's native CPU execution provider as a proxy for onnxruntime-web's WASM backend in the browser; WASM is typically slower.
End-to-end excludes the 1000ms stability debounce in app.js (STABLE_MS) — that's a deliberate UX choice, not pipeline cost.
LLM numbers reflect Groq free-tier capacity at run time, not a SLA.

end_to_end_ms.note: classifier (asamyukta, ONNX CPU proxy) + LLM TTFT; excludes the 1000ms stability debounce and browser-side WASM overhead
